data.name: Rambalak
data.gender_notes: Rambalak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram meaning God and Balak meaning a boy or child, so the name Rambalak means 'God of Thunder' or 'God of Boys'. This name is derived from Hindu mythology and is associated with the god Indra, the god of rain and thunder. The name Rambalak carries the meaning “God of Thunder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rambalak usually hope their child will grow to embody god of thunder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rambalak is a divine name that is believed to bring strength, courage, and victory to the bearer. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is associated with the god Indra, who is the god of rain and thunder. The name is believed to bring the power and energy of the god Indra to the bearer, helping them overcome challenges and achieve their goals.
data.etymology: Rambalak belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Thunder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rambalak total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
